description: Read the DESIGN-TIME contract for an exact handle from quoapi.search (e.g. address.validate): inputSchema/outputSchema, auth/scopes, pricing, availability, regions and REST mapping. Use inputSchema before quoapi.execute. No upstream action or charges are performed; this does not test credentials or provider reachability. Unknown or MCP-ineligible handles return capability_not_mcp_visible. Use quoapi.inspect for runtime health, not contracts.

capability.description: Copy the handle verbatim from quoapi.search capabilities[].handle (for example address.validate). A provider display name, URL or family name is not a handle; missing/ineligible handles raise capability_not_mcp_visible.

name: quoapi.describe
title: Describe a QuoAPI capability
